questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the great paradigms of biology?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Archimedes principle**__ is not a paradigm of biology it is a concept of physics given by Archimedes.
 
• Archimedes principle states that when a body is fully or partially immersed in a liquid, the amount of liquid displaced by the body is equal to the loss of weight of the body in the liquid.
 
• It states that when a body is immersed fully or partially in a fluid, it experiences an upward force that is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by it and this force is known as Buoyant force.
